title: French Journalist Gleizes Waives Cassation Appeal in Algeria, Paving Way for Presidential Pardon
detail: French journalist Christophe Gleizes, detained in Algeria, waived his cassation appeal, potentially opening the path for a presidential pardon from Algerian President Tebboune. The move is seen as a significant step in resolving a diplomatic case that has strained Franco-Algerian relations.
